long_description:
Bravi helps manufacturers of windows, doors, and other home improvement products turn fragmented technical and commercial data into tools their teams can use instantly. 

Our AI platform helps sales, customer service, and field teams answer technical questions, configure complex products, generate quotes, and retrieve order information by connecting to existing documentation, catalogs, ERP, CRM, and pricing systems.

Bravi is already live with leading installers and manufacturers across Europe and the US, turning missed demand into revenue.
name: Bravi
one_liner: AI operating system for home improvement manufacturers
